label: Combat Readability Build
description: Per-BP test contract for BP3 (M3B + M4A + M5 + Double-Click Release Engineering). Declares the tests + evidence + grading dimensions + observe fields + cargo modules + sweep rows + perf gates required for BP3 closure. M3B (replay viewer + debrief) closed in PR #15. M4A (readability + ACC-A floor) lands in this BP per the Roadmap V2 split. M5 (equipment/chassis/damage grammar) closes BP3.

fun_proof_scenarios.description: M4A readability proof on the dedicated m4a_micro_breach_readability scenario (reuses the M1.5 micro_breach world via milestone_override) at 200% UI scale + high contrast + reduced_motion + reduced_shake + reduced_flash + hold_to_confirm + key_remap_enabled. Drives walk → refused dig (out of range) → break wall → fire → reload → take damage so every HUD line (silhouette + module strip + stance + banner stack + tool-validity + captions) carries meaningful values.

M5 acceptance proof: Powered Armor pilot vs Light Mech autocannon. WIN path exercises chassis stage ladder + eject + extraction-zone reach as foot infantry. LOSS path verifies chassis wreck (layered armor → wound → disabled → wreck) ends with mission_resolved {result: lost, reason: player_dead}. Every cfctl chassis method (eject, repair, salvage, clear_jam, crouch, climb, jet) flows through production cf-control dispatch path.

M5 chassis grammar sandbox: repair zone + module, clear jam, toggle crouch/climb/jet movement-intent flags. Confirms every chassis-grade cfctl method works on a Nominal chassis via the production control dispatch path without combat pressure.

supporting_scenarios.description: M4A act.settings.set live-update round-trip: drives ui_scale + high_contrast + captions + reduced_* on then off again to prove the engine's Settings can be patched mid-run and re-observed.

regression_scenarios.rationale: BP3 must not regress BP1's M1.5 fun slice. Re-run with the same seed at the same tick rate; final_sim_checksum must match the BP1 exemplar.
BP3 must not regress BP2's M2.5 fun slice. Re-run with the same seed at the same tick rate; final_sim_checksum must match the BP2 exemplar.

required_source_patterns.description: cf-app must open a playable default scenario or launcher when launched with no command-line args.
macOS release artifact must be a double-clickable app/dmg, not a raw tar archive.
Windows release artifact must expose a double-clickable Corefall executable or installer.
Linux release artifact must be double-clickable/AppImage-class per the release gate.
Body graph must model upper arms (production code uses ArmLeft as the composite/upper-arm zone per the roadmap M5 §spec; legacy UpperArmLeft alias also accepted).
Body graph must model the right upper arm (production code uses ArmRight as composite/upper-arm; legacy UpperArmRight alias accepted).
Body graph must model forearms separately from whole-arm placeholders.
Body graph must model the right forearm separately from whole-arm placeholders.
Body graph must model hands because weapon grip and gear drop are M5 gameplay data.
Body graph must model the right hand (weapon grip socket lives on HandRight per M5 §spec).
Body graph must model thighs (production code uses LegLeft as the composite/thigh zone per the roadmap M5 §spec; legacy ThighLeft alias accepted).
Body graph must model the right thigh (production code uses LegRight as composite/thigh; legacy ThighRight alias accepted).
Body graph must model shins separately from whole-leg placeholders.
Body graph must model the right shin separately from whole-leg placeholders.
Body graph must model feet because gait/limp/crawl consequences are M5 scope.
Body graph must model the right foot because gait/limp/crawl consequences are M5 scope.
Actor sim must consume body-graph movement consequences in the production movement path.
Actor sim must route destroyed arm/hand state into weapon handling.
Actor sim must route destroyed limb/socket state into dropped carried gear.
The M5 win-path sweep must enforce non-blank capture evidence.
The M5 loss-path sweep must enforce non-blank capture evidence.
The M5 salvage sweep must enforce non-blank capture evidence.

main_feature_contracts.source: docs/plan/spec/prototype-roadmap.md M5-DC-3 'no static sliding pawn'; DR-019 visual direction

required_source_patterns.description: Renderer must apply a configurable base scale multiplier so humanoid silhouettes are visually identifiable at battlefield zoom (not a 16x32 flat box).
Renderer must declare a per-zone pip layout so the 15-zone body graph projects to 15 anatomical sprites, not a single rectangle.
Renderer must run a system that materializes per-zone child sprites from chassis_view state every tick.
Renderer must run a system that materializes per-module child pips from chassis_view.modules state every tick.
Renderer must run a system that surfaces the held rifle as a visible pip at the actor's grip socket, oriented along aim vector.
Renderer must run a walk-cycle animation tied to sim tick + velocity so the silhouette is animation-first while controlled (M5-DC-3).
Renderer must surface chassis-stage progression (Nominal → ScuffedI → ScuffedII → Wounded → Disabled → Wreck → Gibbed) through chromatic tinting so a viewer reads the stage without HUD.

required_script_methods.description: The salvage proof script must actually call the salvage command.

required_cli_patterns.description: cfctl must expose M5 crouch, not only raw JSON-RPC script passthrough.
cfctl must expose M5 climb, not only raw JSON-RPC script passthrough.
cfctl must expose M5 jet, not only raw JSON-RPC script passthrough.
cfctl must expose M5 eject, not only raw JSON-RPC script passthrough.
cfctl must expose M5 chassis repair, not only raw JSON-RPC script passthrough.
cfctl must expose M5 chassis salvage, not only raw JSON-RPC script passthrough.
cfctl must expose M5 clear-jam, not only raw JSON-RPC script passthrough.

perf_gates.rationale: 60 Hz tick budget = 16.67 ms/tick frame budget; conservative gate at 8.33 ms (50% of frame). M4A is a HUD-only milestone — no new sim path. Banner + caption queues are O(buffer_size).
120 Hz tick budget = 8.33 ms/tick frame budget; conservative gate at 4.16 ms (50% of frame). Validated via dedicated --tick-rate-hz 120 cf-app run on the m4a scenario.
BP1 regression baseline: m1_actor_range at 60Hz + 120Hz must not regress vs prior BP closures.

Honest down-scope (audit fix 2026-05-10): the M4A perf gates verify the SIM tick budget at 60Hz + 120Hz on a 1280x720 window only. The roadmap's Steam Deck 800p/60, 1080p/60, and 4K/120 RENDER perf tiers are NOT directly verified by the M4A scenario because cf-app does not yet expose a `--window-resolution` flag and the render cost of cf-render-2d is dominated by Bevy/wgpu's per-fragment overhead at the configured window dimensions, not by M4A sim cost. The previous bp3.test_manifest.json overclaimed all three render tiers from a single 1280x720 run; this is the honest version.
perf_gates.owning_milestone: T-PERF (BP4+ when M5.5 / M5.6 introduce render-cost-sensitive systems)
perf_gates.verified_evidence: Sim tick perf at 60Hz + 120Hz is verified above; resolution-tier render perf is the open work.
